page.layout: One column of running text, with no marginal notes; the left and right edges carry only cut-off print from the neighbouring page and show-through. Page number at the top right. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: basilæ, Simeon Thessalonicensis, Iosephi Bryennius, & Philagrius, Marcus Ephesius, & alij schisma propugnarunt, in Romanam Ecclesiam inuecti sunt, magnæ apud Græcos schismaticos existimationis Viri.
Nullus ex his in catalogum Sanctorum relatus est, licet relati sint, qui Pontificiam dignitatem agnouerunt, & vnionem cum illa conseruarunt ad vltimum vsque spiritum.

Hoc certe magnum est, & forte id non confiderauit, sicut & alia multa, Hottingerus. Inspice Græcorum Sanctorum catalogum, reuolue libros Rituales illius Ecclesiæ, interroga Critopulum illum tuum, cuius authoritati tantum defers. Quare fateasimilis necesse est, dum hæc scriberes, te vel sopore solutum, vel in maxima veritatis ignoratione versatum fuisse. Probas id de Palama ex mea Græcia Orthodoxa pag. 809.

Hic etiam schismaticos sequeris, quorum ductu necesse est, vt persæpe in mendacia decidas. Vellem in apertis, & manifestis non impegisses. Quare antequam protulis-ses sententiam, allata ibi ab Allatio oculis apertis non lectitasti? Ibi collocatæ sunt sententiæ in Palamam a nonnullis Græcorum in numerum Sanctorum ascitum.
Nonnulli Græcorum non sunt vniuersi Græci, nec ipsa Ecclesia Græca. Titulum se

page.notes: Catchword "quun-" printed alone at the lower right, set off from the last line. The first line of the page starts with a word fragment ("basilæ"), so the paragraph continues from the previous page. The word "fatearis" in the scan is partly obscured where the line ends; I have read it as "fateasimilis", which is doubtful and should be checked against the scan. Likewise "schismaticos" in the fourth paragraph and "Inspice" are read from the scan with long s rendered as s. Margins contain no readable notes.
